title: The porch, narrowest
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Thursday. The bags on the porch again, three days before the bus. The panels narrow all the way down: four panels, each thinner, the fourth a line. The device's last daily use.

panels.composition: Chloe's porch. The bags. CHLOE on the top step, WOOD on the bottom. Rain. Full width.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a young woman on a porch's top step and a young man on the bottom step beside two packed bags in rain

balloons.text: You could just say you'll be there.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a narrower panel of the same porch scene, closer, a young woman and a young man on the steps

panels.composition: Same, one-third width. Just the two heads.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a very narrow panel showing only two young people's heads in profile in rain, no words

panels.composition: A line. A single vertical black stroke with rain hatching either side. Nothing else fits.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, an extremely narrow panel that is almost only a single vertical black stroke between rain hatching, no words
image.notes: Panel 4 is a line. The narrowing device ends here; the oversized cover Sunday is the answer.

notes: Four panels narrowing to a line. 'I could.'
